local_dod.name: HostBootstrapBindingReceipt
local_dod.pass_rule: host callable invokes canonical owner and returns OWNER_NEXT

local_dod.name: RuntimeExecutionReceipt
local_dod.pass_rule: materialized runtime emits sealed execution receipt

local_dod.name: CohostRelationAttestation
local_dod.pass_rule: B0/R0/R1/R2 qualifier emits sealed attestation from proof refs

local_dod.name: HostRouteInterpositionReceipt
local_dod.pass_rule: runtime route guard accepts only safe externally observed interposition

local_dod.name: NativeDeliveryReadbackReceipt
local_dod.pass_rule: native delivery binds grant and exact runtime turn bytes

local_dod.name: OwnerProvenanceAndSeal
local_dod.pass_rule: Every proof-bearing entity is emitted/observed by its declared owner, externally observed where required, sealed/content-addressed, and never accepted as raw caller-authored status.

local_dod.name: ExactCrossBindingAndFreshness
local_dod.pass_rule: All entities bind the same host session, source head, runtime root/instance, participant and turn where applicable; stale, replayed, cross-session or cross-turn evidence fails.

local_dod.name: FailClosedProjection
local_dod.pass_rule: Earliest missing/invalid physical edge declassifies deterministically: bootstrap -> INTEGRATION_IMPEDIMENT; runtime/cohost -> NOT_READY; route -> SESSION_ROUTE_BLOCKED; native proof -> COHOST_RELATION_ONLY. No invented environment blocker and no later evidence washes out an earlier gap.

local_dod.name: SurrogateRejection
local_dod.pass_rule: App/panel/widget, assistant prefix, forged status, manual selection, FULL_RUNTIME, control ownership, CANONICAL_PRODUCT or legacy ACTIVE cannot substitute physical host receipts.

local_dod.name: AxisOrthogonality
local_dod.pass_rule: Relation, runtime capability, product canonicality, control ownership and native participation remain separate axes; stronger unrelated states are neither necessary nor sufficient for native E2E.

intermediate_dod.name: Evidence substrate
intermediate_dod.pass: proof objects owner-produced/observed and sealed; raw status inputs rejected

intermediate_dod.name: Bootstrap physical binding
intermediate_dod.pass: host invokes canonical bootstrap owner and returns OWNER_NEXT

intermediate_dod.name: Runtime execution
intermediate_dod.pass: exact runtime root executed as concrete runtime instance

intermediate_dod.name: Session route closure
intermediate_dod.pass: runtime-owned guard sees safe host interposition and no bypass/pending/stale state

intermediate_dod.name: Native participant standing
intermediate_dod.pass: persistent native non-user participant with future standing

intermediate_dod.name: Native delivery/readback
intermediate_dod.pass: host publishes exact runtime bytes under participant and binds E5

intermediate_dod.name: E2E closure evidence
intermediate_dod.pass: one same-session evidence chain validates as NATIVE_TRANSCRIPT_ACTOR_E2E

intermediate_dod.name: Persistence witness
intermediate_dod.pass: later turn uses same participant lease and fresh E5/E6 without manual reselection
